item.title: Liquid AI Launches RIPL, a Real-Time Inference Engine for Sub-50 ms LFMs
item.description:
Liquid AI released RIPL, a real-time inference engine for its LFM models. On one B200, LFM2.5-1.2B on RIPL showed 14.4 to 28.4x lower p95 latency than Qwen3.5-0.8B on vLLM.

The post Liquid AI Launches RIPL, a Real-Time Inference Engine for Sub-50 ms LFMs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Gradium Open-Sources Phonon, a 31M-Parameter On-Device TTS Model Under Apache 2.0
item.description:
Gradium has open-sourced Phonon, a family of on-device text-to-speech models. The English Phonon 31m ships under Apache 2.0, fits in 64.5 MB, and starts speaking in about 7 ms on a laptop CPU.

The post Gradium Open-Sources Phonon, a 31M-Parameter On-Device TTS Model Under Apache 2.0 appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Cohere Releases Rerank 5 With Passage-Level Context Focus and Calibrated Scores
item.description:
Cohere Rerank 5 ships in Pro and Fast tiers with a 32K context window, Context Focus passage extraction and calibrated relevance scores. Pro scores 82.2 on BRIGHT and costs $0.05 per 1M tokens.

The post Cohere Releases Rerank 5 With Passage-Level Context Focus and Calibrated Scores appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: A Developer’s Guide to OmniParseBench: Leaderboard Benchmarks and OCR Testing
item.description:
Explore how to audit and rebuild Datalab's OmniParseBench, test parser ranking certainty with document-level bootstrapping, and evaluate Tesseract and Indra OCR performance on a custom sample.

The post A Developer’s Guide to OmniParseBench: Leaderboard Benchmarks and OCR Testing appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: IBM AI Releases Granite Speech 5.0 2B for Multilingual Transcription and Translation
item.description:
IBM released Granite Speech 5.0 2B, an Apache 2.0 speech recognition and translation model. It ranks #2 on the Open ASR Leaderboard with 5.68% average English WER, alongside updated Turbo CTC and 4.1 2B Plus models.

The post IBM AI Releases Granite Speech 5.0 2B for Multilingual Transcription and Translation appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method
item.description:
Perplexity and NVIDIA introduced JOLT, a post-training method that trains one model as both teacher and student. On MATH it matched GRPO’s accuracy with 6.5x fewer processed training tokens.

The post Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: A Coding Guide to Cactus Whistle: Does a 16.9 MB Speech Model Hold Up Against Whisper Base? Word Error Rate, Speed, Streaming, Timestamps, Keywords, and Speech-to-Tool Calls on a CPU
item.description:
Explore a comprehensive coding guide benchmarking Cactus Compute's 16.9 MB speech model against Whisper base. Learn about word error rates, CPU speed, streaming latency, and speech-to-tool integration.

The post A Coding Guide to Cactus Whistle: Does a 16.9 MB Speech Model Hold Up Against Whisper Base? Word Error Rate, Speed, Streaming, Timestamps, Keywords, and Speech-to-Tool Calls on a CPU appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: NVIDIA Nsight Python Tutorial: How to Profile GPU Kernels
item.description:
Discover NVIDIA Nsight Python, an open-source interface that allows developers to profile GPU kernels, analyze hardware metrics, evaluate cache and clock controls, and measure kernel fusion directly from Python code.

The post NVIDIA Nsight Python Tutorial: How to Profile GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params
item.description:
Recursive has released Flint, an Apache 2.0 local coding model with 40B total and 2.5B active parameters. It reports 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 125+ tokens per second on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro.

The post Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents
item.description:
Vercel released durable-harness, an open-source package that logs every model and tool call so Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex sessions resume after crashes, timeouts and redeploys on Vercel, Postgres or a laptop.

The post Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.
